goal: Every grant request reads well at the IdP without special code; Shapes adapters live and are checked only at the IdP; a Pod calls a program like any ordinary program; each user can let a personal Pod shorten their own approvals.
summary: Revision 3 is implemented and live, but it put adapter selection, version checks and command matching into the Pods desktop. Revision 4 moves them to the IdP: the desktop sends the exact command and the program hash, the IdP resolves it with the registry adapter and returns a token bound to exactly this command, and the desktop only verifies that binding. Existing approvals stay valid.

problem.statement: Since revision 3 every Pod program must be assigned a registry adapter in the desktop; the desktop probes the CLI version, matches each call itself and binds grants to the adapter version.
problem.impact: On October 14 the adapter change stopped all Pods (issue 1470), programs with local adapters asked for one approval per message, and every Pod had to be reconfigured by hand; the desktop again carries domain knowledge that should change without a release.
problem.approach: The IdP is the only place that knows Shapes: per call it resolves the exact command with the registry adapter, checks it against the approved grants and issues a short token bound to exactly this command and program hash.
problem.outcome: Programs are assigned by path only; adapter and registry changes need neither a desktop build nor a Pod change; approvals carry over; the desktop is a generic runtime that verifies a binding.

context: Owner decisions October 13–14, 2026: the IdP supports fields such as title, description, command and origin and decides the presentation; the Pods desktop only creates the grant and adds the Pod name. The generic card model was accepted. Revision 3 follows the owner's review: no adapter trust rule (too specific), new summary fields without legacy fields (migration), shape rules accepted centrally through the registry repository, the learning loop is a personal shortcut each user runs for themselves (desktop-integrated or a Pod running with the user's DDISA identity), no evidence leaves the user, and the registry stays current through issues and pull requests. Revision 4 follows the owner's question on October 14 after the rollout: "der Aufruf muss wie gewöhnlich sein - die Adapterprüfung passiert ja erst auf IdP-Ebene ... ansonsten nur in dem Pod, der sie prüfen soll". Observed on October 14: the semantic adapter digest invalidated all stored grants (issue 1470, fixed in PR 415), the desktop treats local adapters as exact commands so Intake requested one grant per message, and six Pods had to be reassigned to registry adapters by hand.
scope: Protocol: summary becomes {title, description, origin, link}; text is removed with a migration of stored grants and all senders (Pods, apes).

Shapes: the shapes-registry is the only adapter source of IdP and Pods; operations carry presentation data and tested CLI versions; registry CI with golden, hostile-option and real-CLI differential checks.

Pods: generic pass-through of script-provided title, description and link; origin = Pod name; programs are assigned by path and file hash only; the desktop sends the exact command and verifies the IdP token binding, without Shapes code.

decisions.title: Generic card, three sources
decisions.description: The card answers who asks, what happens, what it means (allows / does not allow), binding facts and details. Sources: registry adapter presentation data (meaning), requester summary (claim) and IdP facts (agent and owner from registration, validity, batch, grant type). Accepted by the owner on October 14.

decisions.title: Registry is the only adapter source
decisions.description: Adapters exist only in the shapes-registry; the owner accepts rules by merging there. Only the IdP loads registry adapters (revision 4; in revision 3 Pods loaded them too). A command without a registry adapter is shown and approved as its exact command.

decisions.title: Summary fields with migration
decisions.description: summary = {title, description?, origin, link?}; title one line ≤120, description ≤2000, link http(s); no Unicode format or control characters. summary.text is removed: stored grants are migrated (first line → title, rest → description) and Pods and apes send only the new fields; IdP, Pods and apes ship together. The PR 399 script title becomes summary.title.

decisions.title: Shapes principles
decisions.description: Shapes is a dictionary, not an allow-list: unknown means an exact approval; adapters declare tested CLI versions; prefer HTTP grants where a stable API exists; sandbox, scoped credentials and server policies remain the hard boundary. Agreed by the owner on October 14; the handling of untested versions is decision 10 of revision 4.

decisions.title: Personal learning loop
decisions.description: Each user runs it for themselves as a shortcut. Proposed: a Pod running with a DDISA delegation of the user limited to reading the user's own grants and requesting grants for the user's agents; it can never approve, so the user still decides every standing grant at the IdP. Alternative: a generic desktop function without a Pod. To decide.

decisions.title: Registry upkeep without evidence
decisions.description: No evidence leaves the user. The shape maintenance step drafts registry issues or pull requests that contain only the generalized adapter change and synthetic test commands; the user reviews them before anything is pushed, and registry CI plus the owner's merge decide.

decisions.title: Adapter check only at the IdP
decisions.description: A Pod calls a program like any ordinary program: path and arguments. Only the IdP knows Shapes; it resolves the exact command with the registry adapter and checks it against the approved grants. The desktop proves which program runs (file hash) and runs only the command the token names. The personal upgrade Pod reads Shapes through the IdP, nowhere else.

decisions.title: One token per command
decisions.description: The IdP issues a token for at most five minutes, bound to the agent, the target host, the exact argument list (hash) and the program hash. Identical repeated commands reuse it. Rejected alternative: a token per permission with a local coverage check, because it keeps an adapter in the desktop.

decisions.title: Approvals carry over
decisions.description: The IdP matches grants by permission, not by adapter version, so all approved grants keep working after the switch and no Pod asks again for a permission it holds. Grant requests for programs no longer carry client-resolved details; the IdP derives them.

decisions.title: Untested program versions
decisions.description: Open for the owner. Recommended: an untested program hash is matched with the registry adapter of its name and the card shows "version not tested", so reads like Intake's do not ask once per message. Alternative (revision 3): untested versions need exact approvals until a registry pull request adds the hash.

milestones.title: Protocol fields and migration
milestones.goal: DDISA summaries use only title, description, origin and link.
steps: Replace summary {text, link} in grants.md §3.4, grant-request.json and @openape/core; define the presentation block of a Shapes operation in the registry schema.
Migrate stored IdP grants (first line → title, rest → description) and switch Pods and apes to the new fields in one coordinated release.
acceptance: No stored grant keeps summary.text; a request with text is refused; old grants render with their migrated title.
milestones.rollback: Restore the IdP backup taken before the migration and the previous releases.

milestones.title: Registry as the single adapter source
milestones.goal: IdP and Pods use only owner-accepted registry adapters.
steps: Move the Pods git and pod-runtime adapters into shapes-registry via pull request; add tested versions and presentation data.
Registry CI: golden, hostile-option and real-CLI differential checks; IdP and Pods load the registry by digest; a version mismatch falls back to exact approvals.
acceptance: A deliberately wrong adapter fails registry CI; Pods refuses a non-registry adapter path; a version mismatch is visible and asks for the exact command.
milestones.rollback: Revert the registry pull requests and the loader change.

milestones.title: Generic grant card at the IdP
milestones.goal: One card for every grant; the Pod card becomes registry data.
steps: Render the five parts from registry presentation data, summary and IdP facts with clear labels; the batch view shows the card title line.
Delete PodRunGrant.vue and pod-run-grant.ts; show the agent's registered name and owner.
acceptance: Vitest browser screenshots: the Pod run card looks as today without special code; git push, az and mail approvals show meaning and facts; commands without a registry adapter show the exact command and claims only.

milestones.title: Pods as generic pass-through
milestones.goal: Scripts provide title, description and link; the desktop adds the Pod name and sends fields only.
steps: approvals.request and grant requests accept {title, description, link}; origin is added by the desktop; composed display strings are removed; local and relay inbox cards render the same fields.
One signed desktop build shipped together with M1.
acceptance: The rebase Pod shows its headline at the IdP, and a wording change needs only a script edit.
milestones.rollback: Install the previous signed desktop from the rollback folder.

milestones.title: Delegation scope for personal Pods
milestones.goal: A user can let one of their Pods read their grants and request grants for their agents, never approve.
steps: Define delegation scopes for reading one's own grants and requesting grants for one's own agents at the IdP; approval endpoints refuse delegated tokens.
Pods runs a Pod with that delegation when the user grants it.
acceptance: A delegated Pod can list the user's grants and file a request; every attempt to approve, deny or revoke is refused.
milestones.rollback: Revoke the delegation; remove the scopes.

milestones.title: Personal grant upgrade Pod
milestones.goal: Fewer repeated approvals through proposed standing grants.
steps: From registry shapes and the user's previous approvals the Pod proposes a more general standing grant, or explicitly nothing, as a grant request the user decides at the IdP.
The request shows the commands it would have covered and what else it allows.
acceptance: For the IURIO rebase Pod's read commands a proposal appears; push commands get no standing proposal.
milestones.rollback: Pause the Pod; accepted grants remain revocable at the IdP.

milestones.title: Registry upkeep through issues and pull requests
milestones.goal: Adapters follow new CLI versions and real use without user data leaving the user.
steps: The personal Pod notices commands that fit no registry shape (version, definition, operating system) and drafts an issue or pull request with only the generalized adapter change and synthetic tests.
The user reviews the draft before its push approval; registry CI and the owner's merge decide.
acceptance: One real pull request passes registry CI and contains no path, branch name or other user data.
milestones.rollback: Close the pull request; the registry is unchanged.

milestones.title: Per-call authorization at the IdP
milestones.goal: The IdP decides every program call with the registry adapter.
steps: The agent sends program name, program hash, exact arguments, target host and the summary; the IdP picks the registry adapter by name, resolves the command and looks for an approved or standing grant that covers it.

Covered: a token bound to agent, host, argument hash and program hash for at most five minutes. Not covered: one pending request is created or reused and returned with its approval link. Calls have their own rate limit per agent, separate from sign-in.
acceptance: Tests: a covered command returns a token bound to its arguments; a different argument list is refused; client-supplied details are ignored; 500 calls of one agent do not touch the sign-in limit.
milestones.rollback: Redeploy the previous IdP image; the desktop of revision 3 keeps working against it.

milestones.title: Generic program calls in the desktop
milestones.goal: The desktop has no Shapes code: it calls, waits for the decision and verifies the binding.
steps: Programs are assigned by path, file hash and optional runtime descriptor; adapter selection, registry copies, version probe and local command matching are removed.
Before running, the desktop checks token signature, agent, host, argument hash and program hash; Pod run and HTTP grants stay plain permission grants without an adapter.
acceptance: A check fails the build when desktop code imports a Shapes resolver; a registry change takes effect without a desktop build or Pod change; measured p95 latency per program call below 300 ms.
milestones.rollback: Install the previous signed desktop from the rollback folder.

milestones.title: Rollout without re-approvals
milestones.goal: All active Pods keep running after the switch.
steps: Release order: IdP backup, IdP deploy, signed desktop; a desktop schema migration removes adapter fields from program assignments without owner action.
acceptance: After installation every active Pod completes its next run, and no grant request appears for a permission that was approved before.
milestones.rollback: Restore the IdP backup and install the previous signed desktop.

milestones.title: apes uses the same authorization
milestones.goal: One resolution path for Pods and apes.
steps: apes run and ape-shell send commands to the same IdP authorization instead of resolving them with local adapter files; installed local adapters are removed.
acceptance: apes run git status gets a token from the IdP; no file below ~/.openape/shapes is read.

risks.title: Prompt injection through command text.
risks.mitigation: LLM output is only a draft; the user decides grant requests at the IdP and the owner merges registry changes.

risks.title: A delegated Pod misuses the user's identity.
risks.mitigation: The delegation covers only reading grants and filing requests; approval endpoints refuse delegated tokens; the user can revoke it any time.

risks.title: Migration breaks older clients.
risks.mitigation: IdP, Pods and apes ship in one coordinated release with an IdP backup; old stored grants are migrated, not dropped.

risks.title: The registry falls behind.
risks.mitigation: Unknown or mismatched commands still work through exact approvals; personal Pods draft issues and pull requests.

risks.title: Every program call depends on the IdP.
risks.mitigation: An unreachable IdP stops calls as a transient failure that retries; the same dependency exists today for new grants and token minting; identical commands reuse their token for up to five minutes.

risks.title: Load and latency at the IdP.
risks.mitigation: About ten active Pods make well below 2,000 program calls per hour; own rate-limit bucket per agent; latency is measured in M9 before the release.

changelog.text: Revision 1: structured summaries rendered by the IdP.
Revision 2: generic grant card from three sources, Shapes principles, and the learning loop with grant upgrade and shape maintenance Pods.

Revision 3 after the owner's review: registry as the single adapter source instead of a trust rule, summary migration without legacy fields, personal learning loop with a user delegation instead of an IdP service, no evidence leaves the user, widening/narrowing distinction removed.
Revision 3 approved and implemented (PRs 402–415, IdP prod-ab0279cb, desktop with the issue 1470 fix).
Revision 4 after the owner's question: adapter checks only at the IdP with one token per command; programs assigned by path only; approvals carry over; untested versions open for decision.

Gleiche wiederholte Befehle verwenden es weiter. Verworfene Alternative: ein Token pro Berechtigung mit lokaler Abdeckungsprüfung, weil sie einen Adapter im Desktop behält.

entries.source: Approvals carry over
entries.text: Freigaben bleiben erhalten

entries.source: The IdP matches grants by permission, not by adapter version, so all approved grants keep working after the switch and no Pod asks again for a permission it holds. Grant requests for programs no longer carry client-resolved details; the IdP derives them.
entries.text: Der IdP gleicht Grants über die Berechtigung ab, nicht über die Adapterversion; deshalb gelten alle freigegebenen Grants nach der Umstellung weiter und kein Pod fragt eine Berechtigung erneut an, die er hat. Grant-Anfragen für Programme enthalten keine vom Client aufgelösten Details mehr; der IdP leitet sie ab.

entries.source: Untested program versions
entries.text: Ungetestete Programmversionen

entries.source: Open for the owner. Recommended: an untested program hash is matched with the registry adapter of its name and the card shows "version not tested", so reads like Intake's do not ask once per message. Alternative (revision 3): untested versions need exact approvals until a registry pull request adds the hash.
entries.text: Offen für den Owner. Empfohlen: Ein ungetesteter Programm-Hash wird mit dem Registry-Adapter seines Namens abgeglichen und die Karte zeigt "Version nicht getestet", damit Lesezugriffe wie die von Intake nicht pro Nachricht nachfragen. Alternative (Revision 3): Ungetestete Versionen brauchen genaue Freigaben, bis ein Registry-Pull-Request den Hash ergänzt.

entries.source: Protocol fields and migration
entries.text: Protokollfelder und Migration

entries.source: DDISA summaries use only title, description, origin and link.
entries.text: DDISA-Angaben nutzen nur noch Titel, Beschreibung, Herkunft und Link.

entries.source: Replace summary {text, link} in grants.md §3.4, grant-request.json and @openape/core; define the presentation block of a Shapes operation in the registry schema.
entries.text: summary {text, link} in grants.md §3.4, grant-request.json und @openape/core ersetzen; den Darstellungsblock einer Shapes-Operation im Registry-Schema definieren.

entries.source: Migrate stored IdP grants (first line → title, rest → description) and switch Pods and apes to the new fields in one coordinated release.
entries.text: Gespeicherte IdP-Grants migrieren (erste Zeile → Titel, Rest → Beschreibung) und Pods und apes in einem abgestimmten Release auf die neuen Felder umstellen.

entries.source: No stored grant keeps summary.text; a request with text is refused; old grants render with their migrated title.
entries.text: Kein gespeicherter Grant behält summary.text; eine Anfrage mit text wird abgelehnt; alte Grants erscheinen mit migriertem Titel.

entries.source: Restore the IdP backup taken before the migration and the previous releases.
entries.text: Das vor der Migration erstellte IdP-Backup und die vorherigen Releases wiederherstellen.

entries.source: Registry as the single adapter source
entries.text: Registry als einzige Adapter-Quelle

entries.source: IdP and Pods use only owner-accepted registry adapters.
entries.text: IdP und Pods nutzen nur vom Owner angenommene Registry-Adapter.

entries.source: Move the Pods git and pod-runtime adapters into shapes-registry via pull request; add tested versions and presentation data.
entries.text: Die git- und pod-runtime-Adapter von Pods per Pull Request in die shapes-registry übernehmen; geprüfte Versionen und Darstellungsdaten ergänzen.

entries.source: Registry CI: golden, hostile-option and real-CLI differential checks; IdP and Pods load the registry by digest; a version mismatch falls back to exact approvals.
entries.text: Registry-CI: Golden-, Gefahrenoptions- und Echt-CLI-Differenztests; IdP und Pods laden die Registry über den Digest; eine Versionsabweichung fällt auf exakte Freigaben zurück.

entries.source: A deliberately wrong adapter fails registry CI; Pods refuses a non-registry adapter path; a version mismatch is visible and asks for the exact command.
entries.text: Ein absichtlich falscher Adapter scheitert an der Registry-CI; Pods lehnt einen Adapter-Pfad außerhalb der Registry ab; eine Versionsabweichung ist sichtbar und fragt den exakten Befehl an.

entries.source: Revert the registry pull requests and the loader change.
entries.text: Registry-Pull-Requests und Loader-Änderung zurücknehmen.

entries.source: Generic grant card at the IdP
entries.text: Allgemeine Grant-Karte am IdP

entries.source: One card for every grant; the Pod card becomes registry data.
entries.text: Eine Karte für jeden Grant; die Pod-Karte wird zu Registry-Daten.

entries.source: Render the five parts from registry presentation data, summary and IdP facts with clear labels; the batch view shows the card title line.
entries.text: Die fünf Teile aus Registry-Darstellungsdaten, Angabe und IdP-Wissen mit klarer Kennzeichnung darstellen; die Batch-Ansicht zeigt die Titelzeile der Karte.

entries.source: Delete PodRunGrant.vue and pod-run-grant.ts; show the agent's registered name and owner.
entries.text: PodRunGrant.vue und pod-run-grant.ts löschen; registrierten Namen und Owner des Agents zeigen.

entries.source: Vitest browser screenshots: the Pod run card looks as today without special code; git push, az and mail approvals show meaning and facts; commands without a registry adapter show the exact command and claims only.
entries.text: Vitest-Browser-Screenshots: Die Pod-Lauf-Karte sieht ohne Sondercode aus wie heute; git push, az und Mail-Freigaben zeigen Bedeutung und Fakten; Befehle ohne Registry-Adapter zeigen nur exakten Befehl und Angaben.

entries.source: Redeploy the previous IdP image.
entries.text: Vorheriges IdP-Image erneut deployen.

entries.source: Pods as generic pass-through
entries.text: Pods als allgemeiner Durchreicher

entries.source: Scripts provide title, description and link; the desktop adds the Pod name and sends fields only.
entries.text: Skripte liefern Titel, Beschreibung und Link; der Desktop ergänzt den Pod-Namen und sendet nur Felder.

entries.source: approvals.request and grant requests accept {title, description, link}; origin is added by the desktop; composed display strings are removed; local and relay inbox cards render the same fields.
entries.text: approvals.request und Grant-Anfragen akzeptieren {title, description, link}; die Herkunft ergänzt der Desktop; zusammengesetzte Anzeigetexte entfallen; lokale und Relay-Inbox-Karten zeigen dieselben Felder.

entries.source: One signed desktop build shipped together with M1.
entries.text: Ein signierter Desktop-Build, gemeinsam mit M1 ausgeliefert.

entries.source: The rebase Pod shows its headline at the IdP, and a wording change needs only a script edit.
entries.text: Der Rebase-Pod zeigt seine Überschrift am IdP, und eine Wortänderung braucht nur eine Skriptänderung.

entries.source: Install the previous signed desktop from the rollback folder.
entries.text: Vorherigen signierten Desktop aus dem Rollback-Ordner installieren.

entries.source: Delegation scope for personal Pods
entries.text: Delegationsscope für persönliche Pods

entries.source: A user can let one of their Pods read their grants and request grants for their agents, never approve.
entries.text: Ein User kann einem seiner Pods erlauben, seine Grants zu lesen und Grants für seine Agents anzufragen, nie freizugeben.

entries.source: Define delegation scopes for reading one's own grants and requesting grants for one's own agents at the IdP; approval endpoints refuse delegated tokens.
entries.text: Delegationsscopes am IdP für das Lesen eigener Grants und das Anfragen von Grants für eigene Agents definieren; Freigabe-Endpunkte lehnen delegierte Tokens ab.

entries.source: Pods runs a Pod with that delegation when the user grants it.
entries.text: Pods betreibt einen Pod mit dieser Delegation, wenn der User sie erteilt.

entries.source: A delegated Pod can list the user's grants and file a request; every attempt to approve, deny or revoke is refused.
entries.text: Ein delegierter Pod kann die Grants des Users auflisten und eine Anfrage stellen; jeder Versuch, freizugeben, abzulehnen oder zu widerrufen, wird abgelehnt.

entries.source: Revoke the delegation; remove the scopes.
entries.text: Delegation widerrufen; Scopes entfernen.

entries.source: Personal grant upgrade Pod
entries.text: Persönlicher Grant-Upgrade-Pod

entries.source: Fewer repeated approvals through proposed standing grants.
entries.text: Weniger wiederholte Freigaben durch vorgeschlagene Standing Grants.

entries.source: From registry shapes and the user's previous approvals the Pod proposes a more general standing grant, or explicitly nothing, as a grant request the user decides at the IdP.
entries.text: Aus Registry-Shapes und den bisherigen Freigaben des Users schlägt der Pod einen allgemeineren Standing Grant vor, oder ausdrücklich nichts, als Grant-Anfrage, die der User am IdP entscheidet.

entries.source: The request shows the commands it would have covered and what else it allows.
entries.text: Die Anfrage zeigt die Befehle, die sie abgedeckt hätte, und was sie zusätzlich erlaubt.

entries.source: For the IURIO rebase Pod's read commands a proposal appears; push commands get no standing proposal.
entries.text: Für die Lesebefehle des IURIO-Rebase-Pods erscheint ein Vorschlag; Push-Befehle bekommen keinen Standing-Vorschlag.

entries.source: Pause the Pod; accepted grants remain revocable at the IdP.
entries.text: Pod pausieren; angenommene Grants bleiben am IdP widerrufbar.

entries.source: Registry upkeep through issues and pull requests
entries.text: Registry-Pflege über Issues und Pull Requests

entries.source: Adapters follow new CLI versions and real use without user data leaving the user.
entries.text: Adapter folgen neuen CLI-Versionen und der echten Nutzung, ohne dass Nutzerdaten den User verlassen.

entries.source: The personal Pod notices commands that fit no registry shape (version, definition, operating system) and drafts an issue or pull request with only the generalized adapter change and synthetic tests.
entries.text: Der persönliche Pod bemerkt Befehle, die in keinen Registry-Shape passen (Version, Definition, Betriebssystem), und entwirft ein Issue oder einen Pull Request nur mit der verallgemeinerten Adapter-Änderung und synthetischen Tests.

entries.source: The user reviews the draft before its push approval; registry CI and the owner's merge decide.
entries.text: Der User prüft den Entwurf vor seiner Push-Freigabe; Registry-CI und Merge des Owners entscheiden.

entries.source: One real pull request passes registry CI and contains no path, branch name or other user data.
entries.text: Ein echter Pull Request besteht die Registry-CI und enthält keinen Pfad, Branch-Namen oder andere Nutzerdaten.

entries.source: Close the pull request; the registry is unchanged.
entries.text: Pull Request schließen; die Registry bleibt unverändert.

entries.source: Per-call authorization at the IdP
entries.text: Autorisierung pro Aufruf am IdP

entries.source: The IdP decides every program call with the registry adapter.
entries.text: Der IdP entscheidet jeden Programmaufruf mit dem Registry-Adapter.

entries.source: The agent sends program name, program hash, exact arguments, target host and the summary; the IdP picks the registry adapter by name, resolves the command and looks for an approved or standing grant that covers it.
entries.text: Der Agent schickt Programmname, Programm-Hash, genaue Argumente, Zielhost und die Zusammenfassung; der IdP wählt den Registry-Adapter über den Namen, löst den Befehl auf und sucht einen freigegebenen oder dauerhaften Grant, der ihn abdeckt.

entries.source: Covered: a token bound to agent, host, argument hash and program hash for at most five minutes. Not covered: one pending request is created or reused and returned with its approval link. Calls have their own rate limit per agent, separate from sign-in.
entries.text: Abgedeckt: ein Token, gebunden an Agent, Host, Argument-Hash und Programm-Hash, für höchstens fünf Minuten. Nicht abgedeckt: Eine offene Anfrage wird angelegt oder wiederverwendet und mit ihrem Freigabelink zurückgegeben. Aufrufe haben ein eigenes Rate-Limit pro Agent, getrennt von der Anmeldung.

entries.source: Tests: a covered command returns a token bound to its arguments; a different argument list is refused; client-supplied details are ignored; 500 calls of one agent do not touch the sign-in limit.
entries.text: Tests: Ein abgedeckter Befehl liefert ein an seine Argumente gebundenes Token; eine andere Argumentliste wird abgelehnt; vom Client mitgeschickte Details werden ignoriert; 500 Aufrufe eines Agenten berühren das Anmelde-Limit nicht.

entries.source: Redeploy the previous IdP image; the desktop of revision 3 keeps working against it.
entries.text: Vorheriges IdP-Image neu ausrollen; der Desktop aus Revision 3 funktioniert damit weiter.

entries.source: Generic program calls in the desktop
entries.text: Allgemeine Programmaufrufe im Desktop

entries.source: The desktop has no Shapes code: it calls, waits for the decision and verifies the binding.
entries.text: Der Desktop hat keinen Shapes-Code: Er ruft auf, wartet auf die Entscheidung und prüft die Bindung.

entries.source: Programs are assigned by path, file hash and optional runtime descriptor; adapter selection, registry copies, version probe and local command matching are removed.
entries.text: Programme werden über Pfad, Datei-Hash und optionale Laufzeitbeschreibung zugewiesen; Adapterauswahl, Registry-Kopien, Versionsprüfung und lokaler Befehlsabgleich entfallen.

entries.source: Before running, the desktop checks token signature, agent, host, argument hash and program hash; Pod run and HTTP grants stay plain permission grants without an adapter.
entries.text: Vor der Ausführung prüft der Desktop Token-Signatur, Agent, Host, Argument-Hash und Programm-Hash; Pod-Lauf- und HTTP-Grants bleiben einfache Berechtigungs-Grants ohne Adapter.

entries.source: A check fails the build when desktop code imports a Shapes resolver; a registry change takes effect without a desktop build or Pod change; measured p95 latency per program call below 300 ms.
entries.text: Eine Prüfung lässt den Build scheitern, wenn Desktop-Code einen Shapes-Resolver importiert; eine Registry-Änderung wirkt ohne Desktop-Build oder Pod-Änderung; gemessene p95-Latenz pro Programmaufruf unter 300 ms.

entries.source: Install the previous signed desktop from the rollback folder.
entries.text: Den vorherigen signierten Desktop aus dem Rollback-Ordner installieren.

entries.source: Rollout without re-approvals
entries.text: Rollout ohne erneute Freigaben

entries.source: All active Pods keep running after the switch.
entries.text: Alle aktiven Pods laufen nach der Umstellung weiter.

entries.source: Release order: IdP backup, IdP deploy, signed desktop; a desktop schema migration removes adapter fields from program assignments without owner action.
entries.text: Reihenfolge: IdP-Backup, IdP-Deploy, signierter Desktop; eine Desktop-Schemamigration entfernt Adapterfelder aus den Programmzuweisungen ohne Zutun des Owners.

entries.source: After installation every active Pod completes its next run, and no grant request appears for a permission that was approved before.
entries.text: Nach der Installation schließt jeder aktive Pod seinen nächsten Lauf ab, und es erscheint keine Grant-Anfrage für eine Berechtigung, die vorher freigegeben war.

entries.source: Restore the IdP backup and install the previous signed desktop.
entries.text: IdP-Backup zurückspielen und den vorherigen signierten Desktop installieren.

entries.source: apes uses the same authorization
entries.text: apes nutzt dieselbe Autorisierung

entries.source: One resolution path for Pods and apes.
entries.text: Ein Auflösungsweg für Pods und apes.

entries.source: apes run and ape-shell send commands to the same IdP authorization instead of resolving them with local adapter files; installed local adapters are removed.
entries.text: apes run und ape-shell schicken Befehle an dieselbe IdP-Autorisierung, statt sie mit lokalen Adapterdateien aufzulösen; installierte lokale Adapter werden entfernt.

entries.source: apes run git status gets a token from the IdP; no file below ~/.openape/shapes is read.
entries.text: apes run git status erhält ein Token vom IdP; keine Datei unter ~/.openape/shapes wird gelesen.

entries.source: Publish the previous apes version.
entries.text: Die vorherige apes-Version veröffentlichen.

entries.source: Prompt injection through command text.
entries.text: Prompt-Injection über Befehlstexte.

entries.source: LLM output is only a draft; the user decides grant requests at the IdP and the owner merges registry changes.
entries.text: LLM-Ausgaben sind nur Entwürfe; der User entscheidet Grant-Anfragen am IdP, der Owner merged Registry-Änderungen.

entries.source: A delegated Pod misuses the user's identity.
entries.text: Ein delegierter Pod missbraucht die Identität des Users.

entries.source: The delegation covers only reading grants and filing requests; approval endpoints refuse delegated tokens; the user can revoke it any time.
entries.text: Die Delegation umfasst nur Grants lesen und Anfragen stellen; Freigabe-Endpunkte lehnen delegierte Tokens ab; der User kann sie jederzeit widerrufen.

entries.source: Migration breaks older clients.
entries.text: Die Migration bricht ältere Clients.

entries.source: IdP, Pods and apes ship in one coordinated release with an IdP backup; old stored grants are migrated, not dropped.
entries.text: IdP, Pods und apes gehen in einem abgestimmten Release mit IdP-Backup live; alte gespeicherte Grants werden migriert, nicht verworfen.

entries.source: The registry falls behind.
entries.text: Die Registry veraltet.

entries.source: Unknown or mismatched commands still work through exact approvals; personal Pods draft issues and pull requests.
entries.text: Unbekannte oder abweichende Befehle funktionieren weiter über exakte Freigaben; persönliche Pods entwerfen Issues und Pull Requests.

entries.source: Every program call depends on the IdP.
entries.text: Jeder Programmaufruf hängt am IdP.

entries.source: An unreachable IdP stops calls as a transient failure that retries; the same dependency exists today for new grants and token minting; identical commands reuse their token for up to five minutes.
entries.text: Ein nicht erreichbarer IdP hält Aufrufe als vorübergehenden Fehler mit Wiederholung an; dieselbe Abhängigkeit besteht heute schon für neue Grants und Token; gleiche Befehle verwenden ihr Token bis zu fünf Minuten weiter.

entries.source: Load and latency at the IdP.
entries.text: Last und Latenz am IdP.

entries.source: About ten active Pods make well below 2,000 program calls per hour; own rate-limit bucket per agent; latency is measured in M9 before the release.
entries.text: Rund zehn aktive Pods machen deutlich unter 2.000 Programmaufrufe pro Stunde; eigener Rate-Limit-Topf pro Agent; die Latenz wird in M9 vor dem Release gemessen.

entries.source: Revision 1: structured summaries rendered by the IdP.
entries.text: Revision 1: strukturierte Angaben, dargestellt vom IdP.

entries.source: Revision 2: generic grant card from three sources, Shapes principles, and the learning loop with grant upgrade and shape maintenance Pods.
entries.text: Revision 2: allgemeine Grant-Karte aus drei Quellen, Shapes-Grundsätze und Lernschleife mit Grant-Upgrade- und Shape-Wartungs-Pod.

entries.source: Revision 3 after the owner's review: registry as the single adapter source instead of a trust rule, summary migration without legacy fields, personal learning loop with a user delegation instead of an IdP service, no evidence leaves the user, widening/narrowing distinction removed.
entries.text: Revision 3 nach dem Review des Owners: Registry als einzige Adapter-Quelle statt Vertrauensregel, Migration der Angaben ohne Altfelder, persönliche Lernschleife mit User-Delegation statt IdP-Dienst, keine Belege verlassen den User, Unterscheidung Erweitern/Präzisieren entfernt.

entries.source: Revision 3 approved and implemented (PRs 402–415, IdP prod-ab0279cb, desktop with the issue 1470 fix).
entries.text: Revision 3 freigegeben und umgesetzt (PRs 402–415, IdP prod-ab0279cb, Desktop mit der Korrektur zu Issue 1470).

entries.source: Revision 4 after the owner's question: adapter checks only at the IdP with one token per command; programs assigned by path only; approvals carry over; untested versions open for decision.
entries.text: Revision 4 nach der Frage des Owners: Adapterprüfung nur am IdP mit einem Token pro Befehl; Programme nur per Pfad zugewiesen; Freigaben bleiben erhalten; ungetestete Versionen zur Entscheidung offen.
